title: What If Earth Lost Gravity for 60 Seconds? 🌍 (The Terrifying Truth)
description:
What if Earth completely lost gravity for just 60 seconds?

At first, it sounds like pure magic: you drift effortlessly off your kitchen floor, your coffee forms floating liquid pearls, and you can leap 50 feet over rooftops without wings or engines. But as the seconds tick by, the brutal laws of astrophysics kick in...

Why would Earth's 1,000 mph rotation fling you into the stratosphere? Why would 5 quadrillion tons of atmosphere blow out into the vacuum of space? And what happens at the terrifying 60th second when gravity snaps back on?

TIMESTAMPS:
0:00 - The Weightless Morning (Floating Milk & Astronaut Cats)
0:54 - Chapter 2: Playground of Gods (Zero-G Human Flight)
1:44 - Chapter 3: The Tangential Launch (Newton's 1st Law & 1,037 MPH Drift)
2:40 - Chapter 4: Atmospheric Blowout (Airborne Tsunamis & Decompression)
3:33 - Chapter 5: The 60th Second: Terminal Velocity Freefall
4:21 - Chapter 6: The Aftermath & Final Verdict

🔬 THE REAL SCIENCE:
1. Tangential Velocity: Earth spins at 1,037 mph (1,670 km/h) at the equator. Without gravity anchoring surface objects, you travel in a straight line tangent to Earth's curvature at 15 ft/s.
2. Atmospheric Expansion: Earth's 5 quadrillion tons of air are retained only by gravitational force. Zero gravity causes catastrophic decompression into space vacuum.
3. The Fall: When 9.8 m/s² gravity restores after 60s, objects suspended at 800+ feet freefall at terminal velocity (120+ mph).
